text_en: The internet is useful and fun.
We can search for information, watch documentaries and chat with our family.
First, never share personal information, such as your address, school or phone number.
Second, keep your password private, even from friends.
Third, don't click on strange links or download apps without permission.
Also, remember that some news online is fake.
If someone sends you an unkind message, don't reply.
Block them and tell an adult you trust.
Finally, don't forget to spend time offline.
Play outside, read books and talk to your family!
